He sat on the rocks for a long while, the paper trembling slightly in the wind, wondering how many years it had drifted, and whether anyone was still waiting for an answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了静音键。路灯把街道照成橘黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划破空气中的薄雾。便利店还亮着灯，店员靠在柜台上打瞌睡。远处传来垃圾车的声音，还有鸟儿试探性的几声鸣叫，预告着天快要亮了。高楼的窗户大多是黑的，只有几户还亮着灯，像是谁的失眠或者赶工。风很凉，带着一点潮湿的味道。整座城市安静得几乎能听见自己的心跳，仿佛在这短暂的空隙里，所有人都忘记了白天的喧嚣与疲惫。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem\n- It keeps breaking the problem into smaller pieces until it reaches a tiny piece it can solve directly, called the base case\n- Then it combines all those small answers together to get the final answer, like a chain of dominoes falling back into place"}
